climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A region in the Far North of South Australia, the state that makes more than half of all Australian wine. It covers about 1,800 square miles but has only around 430 acres of vines.
